cases.name: handwritten generator source is scanned
cases.source: import java.util.Properties; import java.io.StringWriter; import org.apache.velocity.Template; import org.apache.velocity.VelocityContext; import org.apache.velocity.app.Velocity; class VelocityHelper { void run(VelocityContext context) { Properties properties = new Properties(); properties.setProperty("resource.loader.file.class", "loader"); Velocity.init(properties); Template template = Velocity.getTemplate("demo.vm"); template.merge(context, new StringWriter()); context.put("key", 1); } }

cases.name: implicit java.lang wrapper calls
cases.source: class Demo { void run() { Byte.parseByte("1"); Short.parseShort("2"); Float.parseFloat("3"); Double.parseDouble("4"); } }

cases.name: balanced generic declaration uses the outer receiver
cases.source: import java.util.Set; import jakarta.validation.ConstraintViolation; class Demo { void run(Set<ConstraintViolation<Object>> violations) { violations.isEmpty(); } }

cases.name: method parameter shadow ends after its method
cases.source: import java.util.List; import com.ruoyi.domain.LocalList; class Demo { List<String> rows; void one(LocalList rows) { rows.size(); } void two() { rows.size(); } }

cases.name: nested invocation chain is retained
cases.source: import java.util.List; class Demo { void run() { List.of(1).stream().map(x -> x); } }

cases.name: static imported factory keeps every following chain call
cases.source: import static java.util.Objects.requireNonNull; class Demo { boolean run(String value) { return requireNonNull(value).trim().isEmpty(); } }

cases.name: constructor call retains its first fluent operation
cases.source: import java.math.BigDecimal; class Demo { BigDecimal run() { return new BigDecimal("10").divide(new BigDecimal("2")).stripTrailingZeros(); } }

cases.name: commons text builder retains repeated fluent appends
cases.source: import org.apache.commons.lang3.builder.ToStringBuilder; class Demo { String describe() { return new ToStringBuilder(this).append("id", 1).append("name", "Ada").toString(); } }

cases.name: runtime and Spring utility APIs remain included
cases.source: import java.lang.annotation.Retention; import java.lang.annotation.RetentionPolicy; import org.springframework.context.ApplicationContext; import org.springframework.util.CollectionUtils; @Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME) class Demo { void run(ApplicationContext context, java.util.Collection<?> values) { context.getBean(Object.class); CollectionUtils.isEmpty(values); } }
